+## ➡️ `clever k8s activity` <kbd>Since null</kbd>
+
+Show the recent activity of a Kubernetes cluster
+
+```bash
+clever k8s activity <cluster-id|cluster-name> [options]
+```
+
+### 📥 Arguments
+
+|Name|Description|
+|---|---|
+|`cluster-id|cluster-name`|Kubernetes cluster ID or name|
+
+### ⚙️ Options
+
+|Name|Description|
+|---|---|
+|`-F`, `--format` `<format>`|Output format (human, json) (default: human)|
+|`-n`, `--limit` `<count>`|Maximum number of events to show (default: 10) (default: 10)|
+|`-o`, `--org`, `--owner` `<org-id\|org-name>`|Organisation to target by its ID (or name, if unambiguous)|
+
 ## ➡️ `clever k8s add-persistent-storage` <kbd>Since 4.3.0</kbd>

I added `clever k8s activity <cluster-id|cluster-name>`, but I haven't run it against the API, and I had to guess the format of the events it prints. Lint, typecheck and the docs check pass. `npm run validate` also reports a Prettier warning on `.claude/settings.json`, which the repo already had before my change. `npm test` doesn't exist as a script here, so no unit tests ran.

- **What it does:** it lists the cluster's recent events through the existing `k8sListActivity` helper in `src/lib/k8s.js`. Nothing called that helper before, so I didn't have to add any API code.
- **Options:** `-n/--limit` (default 10), `--org` and `--format human|json`. Human output is a table of date, state, action and message, and `--format json` prints the raw events.
- **Files:** the new command is `src/commands/k8s/k8s.activity.command.js`, registered in `src/commands/global.commands.js`. I regenerated the docs, which changed `k8s.docs.md` and `full-documentation.md`.
- **Unconfirmed event fields:** the endpoint's response isn't documented in the repo, so the table reads the date, state, action and message from several plausible field names. Please run it once against a real cluster and adjust the columns if they come out empty.
- **`since`:** it's `null` as the repo instructions require, so the generated docs show "Since null" until the release workflow sets the version.
- **Not done:** I didn't run the command from source, since that needs a logged-in profile and a cluster. I also haven't committed anything or touched `SKILL.md`.
